name: Health
desc: Kriegsmesser measures your durability and current state in a few ways. Managing these is key to surviving an Expedition.

name: Attacks, Damage, and Injuries
desc: #### Attacks These are Skill Tests made with Weapons to harm a Target, usually by inflicting Damage. Attacks use one of four Principle Skills, and are Resisted by the Same Skill used to make them.

name: Panic, Corruption, and Fixations

name: Disease and Addictions
desc: #### Disease Diseases represent corruption of the body by microbial, fungal, or viral life and other invasive forces. Each Disease is unique as are the ways of contracting and curing them.

name: Actions
desc: What can you do and when? In the course of the game, practically everything you do can be framed as an Action, from speaking to flipping a switch.

name: Elocution
desc: Conversation isn't usually considered a formal Discipline, but a Rhetorician would disagree. Further, that disagreement might just win you over.

name: Faith
desc: Not all magic was disrupted by the Doom. The Priests never depended on the Aether for their abilities. Instead, a priest is Elected to serve a Deity. Within Verdun Noble Families, the first-born chil…

name: Leadership
desc: Good leaders are a rare treasure, one which Trainees of this Discipline hope to achieve. Another time-honored practice, Leadership is a Noble pursuit be convention, but more often achieved elsewhere.

name: Arcane Magic
desc: ## The Aether Before the Cataclysm, magic was breath. The Aether, an omnipresent background of Arcane potential, allowed the Gifted to freely draw on its power. When the World shattered, so did the A…

name: ARCANE
desc: The Discipline of Mages, used to develop their facility with Arcane Runes.

name: BINDING
desc: ## Pacts, the Binder's Arsenal Of the many strange abilities derived from the Abyss, the Binding Pact is the most recognizable. A power of the Principality of Greed, Binding Pacts leverage the Souls…

name: Athletics
desc: Dynamism and release, Athletics directs and controls bodily force. While not necessarily making one strong, it gives the strong new and powerful ways to use their strength.

name: Span
desc: Span instructs its adepts to wait and strike when the moment demands. Primarily a dedication to the Polearm, it still has lessons for almost any warrior.

name: Whirl
desc: The Cleaver is a merciless Weapon designed to cut indiscriminately. Whirl is the Discipline of weaving those cuts into a spinning circle of death.

name: Cascade
desc: An endless barrage of glinting missiles. Practitioners of Cascade are masters of the Knife, specifically of its use in throwing.

name: Honor
desc: A strict Discipline of martial prowess, Honor is the ancient test of will and body, coordinated in the smooth arc of time.

name: Tumble
desc: Once an impractical art, Tumbling is a deadly serious practice for Expeditioners. When terrain, threats, and hazards are totally unknown, speed and avoidance are some of the mightiest shields.

name: Brawling
desc: Hand to hand combat was not looked on favorably in the past, lacking in sophistication. Now, most Verdun outside of the Nobility have little stigma around the concept. In fact, Brawling as a Discipli…

name: Bulwark
desc: Expertise in the use of the Shield, a Discipline of Paladins and protectors. This is often viewed as an essential exercise for any swordsman, and a vital element of Training as a Nobleman or Paladin.

name: Crush
desc: Brutal, slow, effective. The Discipline of Bludgeons. Crush is simplistic, its only function to destroy.

name: Iron Will
desc: An entirely mental Discipline, but hardly academic. Iron Will is the practice of strength, control, and resistance. Adepts of the Iron Will can become more than fearless, as a lack of fear is folly,…

name: Sharpshooting
desc: Archers wield lethality, a tools useful only for reaping. Noble in some respects, many Verdun still regard Sharpshooting with some mixed feelings. Killing from a distance can appear cowardly, and the…

name: Wisdom
desc: Rarest of Disciplines, issuing from an unknown origin, lost in the Doom. Wisdom is not a spiritual practice, is not an art, and is not even properly a Discipline, in truth. Wisdom is a mentality, one…

name: Alchemy
desc: Tonics, Medicines, and other less reputable kinds of substance existed long before the Doom. With the advent of the Expeditionary age and of the confinement within the Arks, it would hardly take a pr…

name: Artifice
desc: The Doom required advancement and, with the introduction of Residue, provided a new kind of fuel for development. Artifice is a Discipline that blends Magic and craftwork, creating otherwise impossib…

name: Surgery
desc: Injuries, especially the more grievous, have been with the Verdun likely before there were Verdun. Then and now, Hospitallers are the usual refuge against these. However, secular means exist for pref…

name: Hunting
desc: Ancient as life, the Discipline of seeking life to take and gather. Hunters would have been a kind of Maker before the Doom, walkers of the wilds and a valuable source of food and goods. Now, the Sha…

name: Scavenging
desc: The Shard Sea is a waste, full of detritus and cast offs and lost things. Scavengers are the experts in finding, adepts of making much of very little. As such, many Expeditioners pick up at least a l…

name: Scouting
desc: Search and discovery are incredibly valuable talents. Scouts are iconic Expeditioners, able to move quickly over long distances and keep an eye on a multitude of threats.

name: Assassin
desc: An Ancient Discipline, the art of taking life. Assassins are at home in the dark, ready to spring at a moment's notice.

name: Guile
desc: Liars are never popular, at least not when you know them. Otherwise, they run the show. While hard to sympathize with and easy to scorn, the Liar is a useful ally when things go bad.

name: Skullduggery
desc: The Discipline of the Thief. Pickpockets and burglars alike practice Skullduggery, as well as Expeditioners, when the need arises.

name: Memory
desc: Scribes have two records, the written word, and the physical brain. Memory is the cultivation of mental capacity, expanding ones inner life in a way that allows its practitioners unnatural accuracy o…

name: Scholarship
desc: Intellectuals and practical researchers alike practice the Discipline of Scholarship; not the study of a subject, but the investigation of knowledge itself.

name: Tactics
desc: The Discipline of collective action, Tacticians studied crowds and formations of soldiers in lost ages. Now, groups are more disorganized, all the more reason for Tacticians.

name: Items in General
desc: #### What is an Item? Items are a subset of Objects, generally requiring you to Equip to benefit from them.

name: Weapons

name: Armor and Shields
desc: #### Armor Armor is a Worn Item, meaning that it Equipping grants a constant passive benefit. Likewise, Armor allows you to negate damage of a specific Rating in exchange for the Armor taking Notches.

name: Consumables
desc: Single-use Items are Consumable, destroyed after being used.

name: Resources

name: The Kinds of Residue
desc: Residue is not a homogenous substance, and can present in a number of different forms.

name: Artifice and Magic Items
desc: Fusions of Arcane study and practical handiwork, Magic Items are manufactured by Artificers to serve a host of purposes within the Ark and beyond.

name: Battles
desc: #### Cards in Conflict Battles are a "zoomed-out" view of Combat, allowing very large scale conflict to take place in a reasonable time. The core element of the Battle is the Unit Card.
